evidence_plan.requirement: Datasets used for human language processing
Types of data used in training

payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the datasets and types of data used in the context of human language processing, including neural and behavioral data.

claims.text: Heterogeneous datasets, including eye-tracking, self-paced reading, and ERP components, are used in human language processing.
Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings are commonly used to study language comprehension.
Neural and behavioral data are utilized to train neural networks for language processing tasks.
